in_marathi.name: Suvo
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suvo हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit word ‘suvam’ which means ‘good’, ‘auspicious’ or ‘blessed’. This name signifies goodness and purity. It is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘su’ meaning ‘good’ and ‘vam’ meaning ‘flow’. The name also represents the radiance and light of the sun.
